description: Turns a source text into finished versions for other channels: a LinkedIn post, an X thread, an email, a blog summary and quote cards. Needs the source text and its type. Optional target formats, brand voice and a key message steer the result. Each version is written from whole sentences of your source, with key points chosen by a stated rule and kept in the source order; claims it cannot support are listed to source, and any requested format it does not know is named. Returns the versions, notes on the key points and proof used, and sector notes.

key_message.description: Optional: the core message to emphasize in every format

source_content.description: The original content to repurpose (a blog post, article or transcript, for example)

source_type.description: The kind of content the source is

target_formats.description: Optional: formats to generate, comma-separated. Defaults to: linkedin_post, twitter_thread, email, blog_summary, quote_cards. Other options: infographic_outline, video_script, podcast_talking_points, slide_deck_outline, newsletter_section. A name outside this list is reported, not written

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: content_repurposer
title: Content Repurposer
